scenes.sub: A liquid staking token (LST) represents staked assets plus rewards, and can be traded or used as collateral. Value accrues by rebasing (your balance grows) or an exchange rate that rises (each token is worth more of the underlying). In stress, an LST can trade
scenes.vo: A liquid staking token (liquid staking token) represents staked assets plus rewards, and can be traded or used as collateral. Value accrues by rebasing (your balance grows) or an exchange rate that rises (each token is worth more of the underlying). In stress, an liquid staking token can trade at a discount to what it redeems for.
scenes.cap: A liquid staking token (LST) represents staked assets plus rewards, and can be traded or used as collateral. Value accrues by rebasing (your balance grows) or an exchange rate that rises (each token is worth more of the underlying). In stress, an LST can trade at a discount to what it redeems for.

scenes.vo: An exchange-rate liquid staking token goes from 1.000 to 1.030 of the underlying over a year: 3%. In a panic it trades at 0.98 on the market. Holders who can wait for redemption (queue) recover 1.03; holders forced to sell take the 2% discount. Never borrow so close to the limit that an liquid staking token discount liquidates you.

lines: Two ways LSTs pass on rewards?
scenes.sub: Answer: Rebasing balances, or a rising exchange rate.

lines: Who is hurt most by a discount?
scenes.sub: Answer: Forced sellers and leveraged holders who get liquidated.
